title: Check the flag-0 promote recipe against its frame operator
body:
## Summary
- Target 34's stored promote recipe is rank 1 and has 9 gates. The operator built from its physical frames has 21 gates.
- Those two operators have the same signed Pauli tableau and the same exact global phase under the pinned native checker.
- The label isometry is not recomputed. No selected frontier change and no new exponent.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/p104-tail-flag0-recipe/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/p104-tail-flag0-recipe/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-tail-flag0-recipe`
- [ ] Confirm the registered replay on the maintainer's Python 3.12 checkout
